description:

Activate Blossom-Clad Werewolf by tapping it, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Lightning Greaves' equip ability by paying {0}, attaching it to Monk Gyatso.
Activate Lightning Greaves' equip ability by paying {0}, targeting Blossom-Clad Werewolf.

Repeat.
